    SELECT AdmFName1 AS name, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName1) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2 AS name, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName2) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 AS name, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
first_names AS (
    SELECT TRIM(
        CASE
            WHEN INSTR(TRIM(name), ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(name), 1, INSTR(TRIM(name), ' ') - 1)
            ELSE TRIM(name)
        END
    ) AS first_name,
    District
    FROM admins
),
counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM first_names
    WHERE first_name <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY cnt DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT fn.first_name, fn.District, c.cnt
FROM first_names fn
JOIN counts c ON fn.first_name = c.first_name
GROUP BY fn.first_name, fn.District, c.cnt
ORDER BY c.cnt DESC, fn.first_name ASC, fn.District ASC
